shared_elements: incised relief carving on a flat frontal face
rows/registers of small repeated signs at the upper part
symmetrical arrangement about a vertical axis
justification: Both are upright stone monuments whose flat front face carries shallow incised carving organised symmetrically about a central axis, with a prominent disc motif and small repeated sign-like elements near the top. However, A is a thin, evenly finished slab densely filled with orderly horizontal lines of tiny script and a figural scene, whereas B is a thick, coarse, weathered block with a few large, sparse, schematic motifs and no register system or text-like rows.
